blocks.text: Product Description               Keep your glass surfaces looking clear and clean with Krud Kutter Window Wash Cleaner, a convenient solution designed to remove dirt, dust, and everyday buildup from windows and other glass surfaces. This formula helps deliver a streak free finish, making it ideal for mirrors, glass doors, and windows throughout your home. Whether you are maintaining interior surfaces or refreshing exterior glass, it provides a simple spray and wipe application that fits easily into your cleaning routine. Use it to improve clarity and maintain a polished appearance across a variety of glass surfaces. From light dust to everyday grime, Krud Kutter Window Wash helps keep your home looking its best.                  From the Manufacturer               Need a reliable, easy to use and safe window cleaner? Krud Kutter's Window Washis perfect for you. Cleans windows without scrubbing, even through screens. Concentrated formula removes tough outdoor dirt and grimee. Dries sparkling without wiping. No Spots, No Streaks! Cleans 40 average size windows. Also cleans Vinyl, Aluminum, & Wood siding.
